page.layout: One column of dictionary entries in Hebrew and Latin, from top to bottom. Running head centred above the text. Page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: כֶּסֶל m. Stoliditas, Stultitia, Psal.49.14. Ilia, Job.15.27. Spes, Fiducia, Exspectatio: Aff. כסלו Spes sua, Job.8.14. Plural. כְּסָלִים Ilia, Levit.3.4. Aff. כְּסָלַי Ilia mea, Psal.38.8.
כִּסְלָה f. Stultitia, Fatuitas: Spes. Aff. כִּסְלָתְךָ Spes tua, Job.4.6.
* כִּסְלֵו m. Kislev, mensis noni nomen, incipiens à novilunio Novembris nostri, Zach.7.1.
כָּסַם Totondit: Infinit. & Futur. יִכְסְמוּ Tondendo tondento, Ezech.44.20.
כֻּסֶּמֶת f. Zea, frumenti genus, quod vulgò Spelta dicitur, Exod.9.32. Plural masc. כֻּסְמִים Et speltas, Ezech.4.9. à sing. כֻּסֶם.
כָּסַס Numeravit, Supputavit: In summam redegit: Futur. תִּכְסְּו Numerabitis, Exod.12.4.

כְּסָה, כְּסַא m. Feria stativa, Tempus statum, quod in Numeratum anni diem semper recurrit, Proverb.7.20. Psal.81.8. Rabbini vocant מועד כסוא Solennitate fixam: Aben Ezra Noviluniũ interpretatur, à כָּסָה Tegere, שמתכסה בו הלבנה quòd tunc Luna Sole Tegitur.
מִכְסָם m. Numerus, Portio numerata, Summa, Num.31.28. Aff. מִכְסָם Et portio eorum, v.40.
מִכְסָה f. Summa, Numeratū: Constr. אֵת־מִכְסַת Summam, Lev.27.23. כְּמִכְסַת Secundum numerum, Exod.12.4. Leniter fine Dagesch, pro מִכְסָה forma מִגְלָה.

כָּסַף Appetivit, Expetivit: Futur. יִכְסַף Appetet, Psalm.17.12. תִּכְסַף Expetes, Job.14.15. Niphal, נִכְסַף Desiderio affici vel teneri: Infin. & Praet. נִכְסֹף Desiderando desiderio tenebaris, Genes.31.30. נִכְסַּף Desiderio afficitur, Psalm.84.3, Particip. נִכְסָף Affecta desiderio, Soph.2.1.

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms, especially in the Kislev, Numeratum and Niphal entries, are read at small size and may be imperfect. The Latin word "Novembris" and "speltas" follow the image as read. The running head and catchword are Hebrew letters as printed.
